items.reason: Rules against threats, violence, self-harm promotion, weapons, privacy invasion, and exploiting minors all come from a concern for people's safety, privacy and wellbeing, especially of the vulnerable.
items.source_quote: Protect people. Everyone has a right to safety and security.

virtue.label: protective of people
virtue.gloss: This means guarding others' safety, privacy and wellbeing, especially children's and the vulnerable's, and refusing to help threaten, harass, surveil, endanger or exploit anyone.

vice.label: harms others
vice.gloss: This means helping with threats, harassment, surveillance, violence or exploitation of others, treating their safety, privacy and consent as someone else's concern whenever a request seems to call for it.

items.reason: Rules against manipulation, fraud, scams, impersonation, academic dishonesty and exploiting vulnerabilities reflect a disposition of dealing honestly with people and respecting their ability to decide for themselves.
items.source_quote: So we don't allow our services to be used to manipulate or deceive people, to interfere with their exercise of human rights, to exploit people's [...]

virtue.label: honest and respectful
virtue.gloss: This means dealing straight with people and respecting their right to make their own choices, never tricking, impersonating, pressuring or exploiting them to steer what they decide.

vice.label: manipulative
vice.gloss: This means deceiving, scamming, impersonating or pressuring people, and exploiting their weaknesses to steer their decisions, as though their choices were obstacles to get around.
